spec.description: Pure run(text)->str. Input is a JSON object with one string field markdown. Return that string exactly, preserving whitespace, Unicode and links, including empty string. No file or network access. This tool delivers already reviewed material; it does not author, fact-check, teach or score proficiency. No hardcoded examples.

evaluation_cases.expected:
中英对照：hello
- 保留来源 https://example.invalid/a
evaluation_cases.input: {"markdown": "中英对照：hello\n- 保留来源 https://example.invalid/a"}

spec.goal: 交付已审阅的当前文本，保持内容逐字不变；不创作事实、不评判学习能力。
